findings.scope: The Face A view of the paired face-B deep-sloper forms, not the seven Face A pocket identities.
findings.interpretation: This is an inherited display-shape approximation also visible in the historical prior-asset preview, not a newly introduced CAD regression. Native/export parity does not establish agreement with the maker image.
findings.limit: No photo measurements were made. The exact intended depth, radius and terminal position are not recoverable from this review; no replacement dimension is proposed. Photo lighting affects the soft lower transition, so confidence is medium-high rather than absolute.
findings.action: Present the whole source and fresh native/USDZ views for explicit human disposition; if correcting, target only this broad relief profile under the source gate. No mutation performed.
